messages:
Alex W: incident-bot just fired SLO burn alert for inference-serving.prod -- 5m burn rate 4.2x. lat p95 spiking to ~1.8s.
incident-bot: [ALERT] slo:service:inference-serving.prod: burn_rate > 3 for 5m (windows: 1m/5m/1h) — trigger_id: sloburn_1765012345
Priya R: hitting this live now, root cause looks like upstream KV cache miss storm after a bad rollout earlier today. seeing drop in cache hit ratio from 95% -> 42%.
Samir: confirmed. a few customers reported tail latency regressions in telemetry. no 5xxs yet.
Tess: paging criteria check — do we want to escalate to paging immediately or try mitigation first? current policy would page SRE at burn_rate>3 for 5m.
Alex W: suggest mitigation-first: reroute traffic to model-variant gen2-small in eu-west while we stabilize caching. that variant has lower memory usage so smaller KV churn. also bump batching window to 30ms for this route.
Morgan: +1 for reroute. can we apply a temporary routing policy? I can push a canary traffic-split to 0.3 -> gen2-small for affected routes.
Samir: also gating low-priority async jobs (vector-embed batch workers) could free up slots. priority_label=background_jobs -> pause.
Priya R: creating incident ticket INC-6742 and adding customer-impact tag. Will follow up with impacted customer list.
Alex W: deploy-bot run:scale_pool --pool inference-eu --delta +2
deploy-bot: scale request accepted, starting 2 nodes in inference-eu (ETA ~4m)
Tess: adding temporary alert muting rule for noisier buckets: set burn alert suppression for internal-learn-test* for 30m to reduce noise.
Samir: code snippet for temporary paging tweak:
```
alert_rule {
  name: slo_burn_high_temp
  selector: service="inference-serving.prod"
  windows: ["1m","5m","1h"]
  thresholds: [5,4,3] // raise small-window thresholds to avoid flapping
  page: false // avoid immediate paging while mitigation in progress
  expiry: +30m
}
```
Priya R: FYI I'm going to update the dashboard with a new panel: KV cache hit ratio by model-variant and per-pool concurrency. will push to dashboards/inference/kv-health in 10m.
Alex W: decision: apply routing canary + pause background jobs + scale pool. keep paging suppressed for 30m, SRE on call stays in thread for escalation. if burn not down to <1.5x in 15m we page.
Morgan: can someone make the call in 15m if we need to escalate? I'll be offline after 20m.
Tess: i'll own the 15m checkpoint. pinging @Samir and @Priya for measurements.
Samir: p95 dropped to 1.2s after canary and batching change — burn rate at 1.8x and trending down.
incident-bot: [UPDATE] slo_burn resolved? No — current burn 1.8x (was 4.2x). continue monitoring.
Priya R: dashboard pushed: https://grafana.internal/d/inference/kv-health (panel id 3) — cache_hit_ratio rising.
Alex W: good work. after stabilization let's add a post-incident action: 1) tighten rolling deploy checks for cache priming, 2) add multi-window burn alert tweak (raise 1m threshold during auto-scale events), 3) create a permanent dashboard for model-variant cache health.
Tess: noted, creating follow-up PRs and will assign owners. tagging this thread into postmortems channel for writeup.
Samir: final note — reenable paging early if any customer reports degradations. otherwise we'll close incident in 45m if stable.
Priya R: INC-6742 updated with timeline and mitigations.
Alex W: thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
